**No. Public evidence cannot establish NVIDIA's realized AI-chip market share in 2030, because 2030 hasn't happened yet.** Today is 2026-10-28, so only projections exist for 2030. Even for past years, no single audited number exists. Estimates for 2026 depend on whether a source counts revenue or units, and on whether it includes hyperscaler custom chips. The "exact realized" part of the question can't be answered even after 2030, unless a source states its definition and method.

I used two searches (of my eight allowed). Both returned search summaries, and I didn't open the underlying pages. Many of the sources are low-quality aggregator blogs, so treat the figures below as indicative.

**Observed in 2026 (estimates, not a census)**
- Estimates of NVIDIA's 2026 share of AI accelerator revenue run from about 70% to 86%. Estimates cluster at roughly 73–75% and 80–85%. Sources: [Alatirok](https://alatirok.com/ai-chip-market-share-2026/), [Blockonomi](https://blockonomi.com/ai-chip-market-statistics-2026-nvidia-amd-broadcom-and-more/), [safeguard.sh](https://safeguard.sh/resources/blog/ai-chip-market-share-2026-nvidia-custom-silicon-training-vs-inference)
- By units, NVIDIA's lead looks smaller. TrendForce is reported to estimate custom ASIC servers at 27.8% of accelerator server shipments in 2026. Sources: [Alatirok](https://alatirok.com/ai-chip-market-share-2026/), [Blockonomi](https://blockonomi.com/ai-chip-market-statistics-2026-nvidia-amd-broadcom-and-more/)
- AMD is estimated at about 5–8% and custom ASICs at about 12–20% combined. Source: [Alatirok](https://alatirok.com/ai-chip-market-share-2026/)
- NVIDIA's share is reported to be falling while its revenue keeps rising. One source cites record quarterly data-center revenue of $75.2 billion. Source: [Blockonomi](https://blockonomi.com/ai-chip-market-statistics-2026-nvidia-amd-broadcom-and-more/)

**Projections for 2030 (not observed outcomes)**
- Bloomberg Intelligence expects NVIDIA to hold 70–75% through 2030, with AMD at a minimum of about 10%. This is the most authoritative source I found. Source: [Bloomberg Intelligence](https://www.bloomberg.com/company/press/ai-accelerator-market-looks-set-to-exceed-600-billion-by-2033-driven-by-hyperscale-spending-and-asic-adoption-according-to-bloomberg-intelligence/)
- Celadon Research projects a decline toward about 70% by 2030, and cites Kearney's 90%-to-70% projection. Source: [Celadon Research](https://celadonresearch.com/research/nvidia-ai-accelerators-q1-2026)
- Northwise Project projects 62% for NVIDIA, 26% for AMD and 12% for ASICs. The source is a blog of lower quality. Source: [Northwise Project](https://northwiseproject.com/research/ai-accelerator-market-forecast-2030)
- Sparkco's base case is 85%, with a range of 75–90%. Its market-size figures are internally inconsistent. Source: [Sparkco](https://sparkco.ai/blog/nvidia)
- Pocket Option projects 55–65%. This is the lowest estimate and the source is weak. Source: [Pocket Option](https://pocketoption.com/blog/en/knowledge-base/markets/nvda-stock-prediction-2030/)

**What the projections support**
- Most projections put NVIDIA at roughly 55–75% in 2030, with a few outliers. They broadly agree on gradual erosion from custom silicon and AMD, with NVIDIA still dominant. The spread, from 55% to 85%, shows the number is not known.
- Market-size estimates for 2030 also vary widely, from about $500 billion to $1 trillion, depending on scope. Source: the [search summary of Sparkco and others](https://sparkco.ai/blog/nvidia).

**Caveats**
- I did not follow the skill's subagent and notes-file workflow, because it needs shell access that you ruled out.
- A real 2030 answer would need NVIDIA's fiscal 2030 and 2031 filings, plus Broadcom, AMD, Google and AWS disclosures. It would also need a stated definition of the denominator, which could be revenue or units, and merchant chips only or including captive silicon.
